notes.title: VHS Collection: Buried Alive Announcement!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Everyone Rick and the Notick Team are here![/p][p][/p][p]We are so glad to be announcing our next project [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816170/VHS_Collection_Buried_Alive/"]VHS Collection: Buried Alive [/url] with everyone![/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816170/VHS_Collection_Buried_Alive/"]VHS Collection: Buried Alive[/url] is also currently available for you to wishlist[/p][p][/p][p]The game is gonna be hopefully something much better then Goodnight me since this time we decided[/p][p]to look at the opinions of the players which did help us a lot moving forward with the project and that's thanks to yall![/p][p][/p][p]if you want to hear more about the game feel free to join our [url="https://discord.gg/bVuPcbmBck"]discord [/url] where we will be posting exciting updates whenever we can![/p][previewyoutube="vsB17fx8Ym4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: An important Message/Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey yall Rick here!

Today i have 2 things for yall lets start with the first one!

[b][h3]The message[/h3][/b]

I would like to thank everyone who gave this game a chance and I’m really glad and thankful for everyone who liked the game despite all it’s issues!

[b][h3]The Announcement[/h3][/b]

I’ve started working on the next part of the series and i promise to make the story clearer for both the first and second game and i also promise to deliver an enjoyable experience for everyone and that’s why i want to ask everybody who’s interested to join the official discord server https://discord.gg/PgWx8nKRpw and write their feedback and suggestions there I’ll be sure to make a special channel for it and of course when it’s the time I’m gonna share some stuff about the next game!

[b]So this was it for now Rick is out.[/b]

notes.title: Ready for the Hunt?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Rick here!

I just wanted to give you all a quick heads-up: VHS Collection: Goodnight Me is releasing in two weeks! Who's ready to dive into the mystery, piece together the clues, and experience the chilling atmosphere of this VHS-styled horror adventure?

Mark your calendars, because the countdown has begun. Get ready to uncover what’s lurking in the shadows it’s almost time. See you on release day!ːsteamhappyː
